summary: Vista Energy files a Form 6-K reporting a routine share repurchase of 50,000 Series A shares at MXN $1,128.97 per share for ~MXN $56.4 million, under an April 2026 shareholder meeting authorization. Citi Mexico executed the buyback. The filing is a standard capital return disclosure, not a special situation. No premium, advisor, or structural complexity exists. Only an issuer's routine open-market repurchase update—no activist, tender offer, or restructuring event. Watch for continued buyback pace but no risk-arb angle.
